_why: Word ceilings for the prose a session reads WHOLE that no role in daoris.json names: the standing orders (until they become the brief, LAYOUT6), the consuming story, the forward sequence, the contract. A declared document's ceiling lives in daoris.json's documents, never here as well (DOC4). tools/doc-budgets.mjs owns the rule, the discipline when one goes red, and why the append-only records have none. Raising a ceiling is a one-line diff where it is written, justified in the commit.
